description: This is a shell script for automated testing of Git rebase operations involving internationalization (i18n) encoding conversions, including setup, test cases, and helper functions.

methods.name: compare_msg
methods.description: Compares the commit message file with an expected output after encoding conversion.

methods.name: test_rebase_continue_update_encode
methods.description: Tests the rebase --continue operation when updating commit encoding from one charset to another.
